title: Pre-earnings run-up: long the top realized-volatility tercile ten sessions before the report, exit the session before it
references: Gao, Hu and Zhang (pre-announcement run-up and uncertainty about the announcement)
Frazzini and Lamont (2007), The Earnings Announcement Premium and Trading Volume
Barber, De George, Lehavy and Trueman (2013), The Earnings Announcement Premium Around the Globe, Journal of Financial Economics
Johnson and So (2018), Asymmetric Trading Costs Prior to Earnings Announcements: Implications for Price Discovery and Returns, Journal of Accounting Research
hypotheses: LONG only, over decisions 2016-08-01..2026-07-17 on cohort v3 (config/research/pooled/cohort-v3.json, the 1,000-name liquidity band) with the 10:35 New York decision clock, ATR14 and eligibility (price floor and 20-session median dollar volume as of the prior close) of the cached cohort-v3 label cube and the events protocol's pinned Nasdaq calendar archive and corporate-actions acquisition. Events: for each deduplicated archive row of a cohort symbol with report date E, E must be an observed session; the decision session is D = E - 10 sessions and must lie in the window and the calendar; another report of the symbol in the 40 sessions before E excludes the row (recent_previous_report); an identity break on or after the first session of the volatility window, or a structural corporate action (anything but a cash dividend) within 5 calendar days of [D, E], excludes it; the cube's eligibility at D must hold. Uncertainty: rv is the standard deviation of daily log returns of adjusted closes over the 60 sessions ending D-1, with at least 55 finite returns; among every cube-eligible cohort name at D with a finite rv, rank ascending (ties by the cube's tiebreak); rank r of n falls in tercile floor(3r/n); the event is a leg when its tercile is 2 (the top), otherwise an announcer row kept for descriptive statistics only. Trade: decision at 10:35 on D, fill at the open of the first regular hourly bar at or after the decision, stop 2.0 x ATR(14) below the decision price, no target and no trail, time exit at the close of the 10th session after D, which is E-1; costs 5, 15 and 25 bp per side, 15 bp decides. Hold window: every labelled row (leg, announcer, placebo or control cell) must fill on its decision session and exit by the close of its 10th session (D+9, which is E-1 for a leg); otherwise it is excluded as hold_outside_window, counted by reason, decision year and role, and a control cell that fails it leaves its pair unpaired. Controls: for each leg (and each placebo, on its D'), the mean of 5 cube cells on the same session D, cube-eligible, in the leg's dollar-volume tercile and the top rv tercile, not legs on D (not placebos on D' for a placebo), with no archive report date in [D-30, D+10] (no release inside its own hold and the legs' clean recent history: a leg has no other report in [D-30, E)), covered by the archive (at least one report date in the 130 sessions before D), nearest in 20-session return to D-1, ties by tiebreak; fewer than 5 leaves the leg unpaired. P1: mean net_excess_r_v1 (beta-matched SPY, per-name cost) of legs > 0 with the bootstrap ci90 lower bound > 0. P2: mean r_cost(leg) - mean r_cost(control) over paired legs > 0 with the paired ci90 lower bound > 0, pairs keyed by D. P3: the 1%-trimmed mean of net_excess_r_v1 > 0 and its mean over decisions from 2023-01-01 > 0. P4: at least 1,000 legs with a finite net_excess_r_v1, at least 300 from 2023-01-01. P5: the legs' paired difference (P2's statistic) minus the placebos' paired difference > 0, with the ci90 lower bound > 0 from one joint stationary session-block bootstrap over the union of the legs' and placebos' decision sessions (the same seed): the legs must beat their controls by more than the pseudo-events beat theirs. Negative control: every leg gets one pseudo-event, the same symbol at a session D' drawn with seed 20261107 from the sessions within 63 of D with no archive report date in [D'-10, D'+20]; a second draw of a (symbol, D') already drawn is dropped and counted (duplicate_session); D' runs through the identical gates, labels, controls and statistics; its P2 must not hold and P5 must hold. Planted effect: before the legs' statistics, every paired placebo leg gets a planted return of 0.0063 of the decision price (converted to R per row) in r_cost and net_excess_r_v1, and P1 and P2 on that frame must both hold; planted.json also records the minimum detectable effect of the placebo P2, (1.645 + 0.84) x its bootstrap standard deviation. Stationary session-block bootstrap over decision sessions, block mean 10, 2000 draws, seed 20261106; ci90 = [5th, 95th] percentiles. See docs/superpowers/specs/2026-11-06-apriori-runup-design.md.
decision_rule: This is a development read: it can only return survives_development, failed or inconclusive_underpowered, and none of them authorizes a probe, a card, promotion, shadow or registry credit. inconclusive_underpowered if the planted check fails; else failed if any of P1-P5 fails or the placebo's P2 holds; else survives_development, which only makes a separately specified prospective read eligible, declaring its own alpha. No threshold, proxy, lead, stop, cost, window, tercile or control parameter is revisited after the run; any change is a new version with a new, non-overlapping window. Realized-volatility splits and every other diagnostic are descriptive and decide nothing.
